alkylation_concentration.evidence: The pellet was then washed 4 times with 100 % cold acetone. Residual acetone was removed and the pellet was resuspended in urea buffer comprised of 8 M urea, 100 mM 4-(2-hydroxyethyl)-1-piperazineethanesulfonic acid (HEPES) (pH 7.2), 1 mM EDTA, 2 % (w/v) SDS, protease inhibitors cocktail (PI) (Calbiochem) and 100 mM N-ethylmaleimide (NEM) (E3876, Sigma) dissolved in ethanol.
Samples were further alkylated by adding 5 mM (final concentration) d5-NEM (DLM-6711, CIL) and incubated (50 °C, 30 min, 1200 rpm shaking).

Following precipitation with 20 % TCA, the samples were resuspended (250 μl) in urea buffer, reduced with 5.5 mM TCEP and further alkylated by adding 100 mM d5-NEM (dissolved in ethanol) (final concentration).

cleavage_agent.evidence: In brief, after loading, samples were washed with 90:10 % methanol/50 mM ammonium bicarbonate and then digested (1.5 h, 47 °C) with trypsin (1:50 trypsin/protein).

fractionation_method.evidence: Each sample was fractionated offline using high-pH reversed-phase separation, followed by online low-pH reversed-phase separation.

fragmentation_method.evidence: MS2 was performed in the Orbitrap after HCD fragmentation, with resolution set to 15,000 and maximum injection time set to 60 msec.

instrument.evidence: The nanoUPLC was coupled online through a nanoESI emitter (10 μm tip; New Objective; Woburn, MA, USA) to a quadrupole orbitrap mass spectrometer (Orbitrap Fusion Lumos, Thermo Scientific) using a FlexIon nanospray apparatus (Proxeon).

ionization_type.evidence: The nanoUPLC was coupled online through a nanoESI emitter (10 μm tip; New Objective; Woburn, MA, USA) to a quadrupole orbitrap mass spectrometer (Orbitrap Fusion Lumos, Thermo Scientific) using a FlexIon nanospray apparatus (Proxeon).

labeling.evidence: inferred: The quantitative comparisons were calculated using Perseus v1.6.15.0. Decoy hits were filtered out, and only proteins/peptides that were identified in at least 50 % of the replicates of at least one experimental group were kept.

mass_analyzer.evidence: Data were acquired in DDA mode, using a 2-sec cycle method. MS1 was performed in the Orbitrap with resolution set to 120,000 (at 200 m/z) and maximum injection time set to 246 msec. MS2 was performed in the Orbitrap after HCD fragmentation, with resolution set to 15,000 and maximum injection time set to 60 msec.
